verdict: Local visibility is growing; paid pipeline is not yet active.
narrative: This period, all activity came through organic channels — no paid ads ran on Meta or Google. Your Google Business Profile was the standout: 52 total actions over 26 days, with an 80% week-over-week lift confirming that local search interest is building steadily, not spiking. Website sessions also rose 41% week-over-week, showing consistent organic momentum. That said, 356 profile impressions produced only 3 calls this period, which points to a gap between people finding you and people reaching out — we're addressing that directly. Conversion tracking is also being repaired so that leads arriving through the website can be counted accurately going forward.
